method: Actual source-bound differential masks and same-pose native repeats. Full-coverage white body mask excludes background-contaminated antialias edges; positive eye masks remain depth tested. Courier P90 versus64-sample ground-ring median, reporting both .02 and .05 offsets.

rows.maskRule: Non-eye luminance uses white-mask RGB channels >=240 (full coverage); partially covered silhouette pixels mix the warm floor into native RGB. Eye support uses the full positive differential mask, a conservative eye maximum.
